name: andBeyond Amazon Explorer

seo.title: andBeyond Amazon Explorer: Peruvian Amazon Yacht
seo.description: andBeyond Amazon Explorer, a 15-suite river yacht for 32 guests in the Peruvian Amazon from December 2026: 3, 4 or 7 nights from Nauta into Pacaya-Samiria.

tagline: andBeyond's first river yacht: 15 suites on the rivers that make the Amazon.
answer: The andBeyond Amazon Explorer is a 74 m river yacht that starts sailing the Peruvian Amazon in December 2026. She carries up to 32 guests in 15 suites and runs three, four or seven nights from Nauta, near Iquitos, on the Marañón, Ucayali and Amazon rivers through the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve. Children aged 8 and over sail. She suits couples, families and small groups.
facts: For andBeyond by SIMA Shipyard; sets sail December 2026
8 and over (any age on private charter)
overview: The Amazon Explorer is andBeyond's first boat on a river. She is 74 m long, five decks high and built for them by SIMA Shipyard, with solar panels covering part of her power. Interiors use Shipibo-inspired patterns and Peruvian textile work, most of it made in the region.

There are 15 suites: twelve 33 sq m Luxury Suites on the upper deck, eight of which pair up as connecting rooms for families, then two 50 sq m Superior Suites and one 80 sq m Deluxe Suite with a 33 sq m balcony on the grand deck. The main deck holds the dining room, the Explorer Centre for naturalist talks, a media room, a gym and a wellness centre with two treatment rooms, and the River Retreat with its pool. The Pisco Bar is on the grand deck and a splash pool sits on the sundeck.

She sails from Nauta, about two hours by road from Iquitos, into the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve. Days run on electric skiffs, kayaks and forest walks, with night outings for caimans and frogs and visits to river communities. There is one route for high water, December to June, and one for low water, July to early December, each sold as three, four or seven nights.
why: andBeyond runs her on its safari model: guides trained across its African and South American lodges, small skiff groups and an Explorer Centre for briefings. Two pairs of Swarovski binoculars per suite are included, along with drinks, laundry and Starlink. The high and low water routes are different trips, so a returning guest can come back in the other season and see a different river.

days.title: Tuesday: arrival
days.summary: Met at Iquitos airport for the drive of about two hours to Nauta, past white sand forest and the Allpahuayo-Mishana reserve. Board, then a first skiff outing and a night excursion with flashlights.

days.title: Wednesday
days.summary: Sunrise birding from the Pisco Bar deck, then a skiff run for sloths, squirrel monkeys and saddleback tamarins. Late afternoon on the blackwater Yarapa River, sundowners and a night search for caimans.

days.title: Thursday
days.summary: Pre-breakfast skiff into the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve for monk saki monkeys and macaws, then a kayak watching for pink and grey river dolphins. Afternoon skiff for hoatzin and a night excursion.

days.title: Friday
days.summary: Early skiff to El Dorado Lake for a picnic breakfast, kayaking, piranha fishing and an optional swim. On the 4-night trip this is the last night, with the captain's farewell dinner.

days.title: Saturday
days.place: Ucayali River to Marañón River, Nauta
days.summary: Skiff to Nauta for the food market and Sapi Sapi lake, known for turtles, paiche and caimans. Afternoon on board, with an optional floatplane flight or spa treatment at extra cost.

days.title: Sunday
days.summary: Skiff with a picnic breakfast looking for river dolphins, with optional swimming and kayaking. Afternoon piranha fishing, sundowners on the bank and a night excursion for owls and caimans.

days.title: Monday
days.summary: Early visit to a shamanic community to learn about medicinal plants, then a guided walk for poison dart frogs and tarantulas and a river community visit. Last night on board, with the captain's farewell dinner.

days.title: Tuesday: departure
days.summary: Disembark at Nauta and transfer to Iquitos for a guided city tour, the Museum of Indigenous Cultures and the Rubber Boom buildings of the Plaza de Armas, then brunch and the airport.

pricesNote: Per person sharing, per cruise, USD, VAT included, as published by andBeyond (rate pages read 1 Nov 2026), valid 15 Dec 2026 to 10 Jan 2028. Rates are the same in both seasons. Private charter is per yacht per cruise. Single supplement 25% (singlePrices computed from it). Children 8 to 16 sharing with one or two adults get 20% off the adult rate (childPrices computed). Embarkation: 3 nights Saturday to Tuesday; 4 nights Tuesday to Saturday; 7 nights Tuesday to Tuesday. Arrive Iquitos by 14:00; fly out 14:00 or later. andBeyond's early bird (20% off for bookings made 9 Jan to 31 Oct 2026) has closed. Honeymoon offer: 50% off one partner's accommodation, travel within 6 months of the wedding, valid 15 to 20 Dec 2026 and 11 Jan to 20 Dec 2027.
inclusions: Soft drinks, house wines, local brand spirits and beers, tea and coffee
Scheduled transfers between Iquitos airport and Nauta
Two pairs of Swarovski Optik binoculars per suite
Guides' Journal and area map with Star Birds checklist
Daily excursions: guided walks, skiffs, kayaking, community visits
Iquitos city tour and brunch on departure day
Emergency medical evacuation insurance (per andBeyond brochure)
exclusions: Cigars, champagne, cognac, fine wines and premium spirits
children: Children aged 8 and over on scheduled cruises, up to 8 children on board at once; younger children only on private charters. Ages 8 to 16 sharing with adults pay 80% of the adult rate. Two triples available, in the Superior Suites (brochure also lists a triple option in the Deluxe Suite). WILDchild programme on board.
faqs: Where does the andBeyond Amazon Explorer sail?

In the Peruvian Amazon. She boards at Nauta, about two hours by road from Iquitos airport, and works the Marañón, Ucayali and Amazon rivers in and around the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve. She does not sail from Manaus in Brazil.
andBeyond lists her launch as December 2026, with rates from 15 December 2026.
How much does a cruise cost?

Per person sharing, USD: 3 nights from 5,190 in a Luxury Suite to 10,710 in the Deluxe Suite; 4 nights 6,920 to 14,280; 7 nights 12,110 to 24,990. A private charter is 147,540 for 3 nights, 196,720 for 4 and 344,260 for 7.

High water, December to June, puts the skiffs into flooded forest and lakes such as El Dorado. Low water, July to early December, opens forest trails and oxbow lakes such as Clavero, and andBeyond rates it well for dolphins and wading birds. The price is the same.

Meals, soft drinks, house wine, local spirits and beer, laundry, Starlink internet, binoculars, all scheduled excursions, transfers between Iquitos airport and Nauta, and the Iquitos city tour. Flights, premium drinks, spa treatments, the floatplane and gratuities are extra.
Ages 8 and over on scheduled sailings, with a maximum of 8 children on board. Ages 8 to 16 get 20% off. Any age can sail on a private charter. Eight Luxury Suites connect in pairs for families.
Up to 32 guests in 15 suites: 12 Luxury, 2 Superior and 1 Deluxe.
No. andBeyond lists her as not wheelchair accessible.
